description: Delivery app reports: their post to the Telegram reporting group (posted once as one block, then late files). Written by klik_pos/api/delivery_app_media.py.

fields.description: Delivery Report name. Plain text, not a Link, so deleting a report is never blocked by this record.
fields.label: Delivery Report

fields.description: When the report was posted to the group (text, voice, photos as one block). Blank while waiting for its files.
fields.label: Posted At

fields.description: Telegram message id of the report's text in the reporting group; late files are sent as replies to it. Blank if that send failed.
fields.label: Summary Message ID

fields.description: Message carrying the 'files missing' warning caption; it is removed once every file is in.
fields.label: Warning Message ID

fields.description: Every expected photo and the voice note have been posted.
fields.label: Done

fields.description: File URLs already posted to the group, so none is posted twice.
fields.label: Posted URLs

fields.description: The posted album, in order: each photo's message id and file URL. A slot with no URL is a placeholder waiting for its photo.
fields.label: Photo Slots

fields.description: Report revision the posted text shows; a driver's edit raises the report's revision and the text is edited in place.
fields.label: Text Revision

fields.description: Telegram message id of the posted voice note, so an edit that replaces or removes it can delete it.
fields.label: Voice Message ID

name: Delivery Telegram Post
